description:
Desktop capacity and quota monitor for coding assistants.

Ceiling is a local-first Windows app for monitoring provider-reported capacity and quota usage across AI coding platforms.
Antigravity now uses Google's official read-only agy CLI exclusively, Gemini Code Assist and Claude Code session handling are safer, and desktop startup, token accounts, updater selection, and Settings error handling are hardened.

Changed:
- Antigravity uses the official agy CLI only (removes the unofficial local language-server probe; requires Antigravity CLI 1.2.13+ on Windows).
- Gemini Code Assist reads ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json read-only without scraping Gemini CLI or modifying credentials.

Fixed:
- Preflight check prevents Claude Code sign-outs when credentials cannot be persisted during OAuth refresh.
- Hardened Grok refresh, Copilot Enterprise host validation and credential scoping, login browser URL allowlisting, and CLI subprocess timeouts.
- Removed unused browser-cookie scanning helpers and test.
- Fixed visible startup deadlock, WebView2 rebuild backoff, poisoned lock recovery, token-account cache eviction and scoping, Settings error banner and privacy masking, and taskbar flyout localization.
- Excluded Store bundles from self-updater selection while keeping superseded ones prunable, and hardened settings backup quarantine.
